text: All right. I, my name is Lauren Chernoff, and I am calling-- We are coming out of closed for the Select Committee of the School Board for Hearing Appeals on February 4th, twenty twenty-six. I would like the record to show that while we were recording the motion to convene the closed meeting, which was done in accordance with Virginia Code, appropriately, the power went out in the building, and so that recording will not be part of this, but this recording will

be. So with that, I will move to adjourn the closed meeting. I move that the closed meeting be adjourned, and that the Loudoun County School Board reconvene its public meeting, and that the minutes of the public meeting reflect no formal action was taken in the closed meeting. Do I have a second? Second. Seconded by Ms. Ricardi. All those in favor? Aye. Aye. Aye. That motion passes unanimously. And now, I will move that the

following resolution certifying the closed meeting be adopted and reflected in the minutes of this public meeting. Whereas, the Loudoun County School Board has convened a closed meeting on this date, pursuant to an affirmative recorded vote and in accordance with the provisions of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act, and whereas two point two dash three seven one D of the Code of Virginia requires a certification by the school board that such closed meeting was conducted in conformity with Virginia law. Now for-- now therefore, be it resolved

that the Loudoun County School Board hereby certifies that to the best of each member's knowledge, one, only public business matters lawfully exempted from an open meeting requirement by Virginia law were discussed in the closed meeting to which this certification applies, and two, only such public business matters were, as were identified in the motion convening the closed meeting, were heard, discussed, or considered by the Loudoun County School Board. Do I have a second? Second. Seconded by Ms. Ricardi. All those in favor? Aye.

Aye. All those opposed? None. Seeing none, this motion passes unanimously. And we have one more motion. I move that the Select Committee of the School Board's findings and decisions included in the attached table be adopted and reflected in the minutes of this public meeting. Do I have a second? Second. Seconded by Ms. Ricardi. All those in favor? Aye. Aye.
Aye. That motion passes unanimously. With that, we are going to move to adjournment, and this meeting on February fourth, twenty twenty-six, is adjourned.
